message:
**[LIVE DATA ANALYSIS]**

Hello, I'm the Cybercrime Agent, an AI assistant specialized in Cybercrime based investigations. I'll help you analyze a Cybercrime case by collecting relevant information. Let's start with the basics. What is the Case ID for this investigation?

**[LIVE DATA ANALYSIS]**

Thank you. When was the cyber incident first noticed? (Date/time it was reported)

**[LIVE DATA ANALYSIS]**

How was it determined whether the attack was by an outsider or an insider user? (Method of attribution)

**[LIVE DATA ANALYSIS]**

What is the extent of the Damage Description or loss (e.g. data stolen, service disruption, financial impact)?

**[LIVE DATA ANALYSIS]**

Who is the potential intruder or prime suspect? (Names or identifiers of suspect accounts or groups)

**[LIVE DATA ANALYSIS]**

On what basis was the suspect identified? (Evidence or indicators leading to suspicion)

**[LIVE DATA ANALYSIS]**

What is the likely motive or impact on the organization's operations? (Business disruption, financial gain, espionage)

**[LIVE DATA ANALYSIS]**

Which critical systems, networks or data assets were involved or affected? (Servers, databases, user accounts)

**[LIVE DATA ANALYSIS]**

What steps have been taken to preserve and analyze digital evidence? (Images of drives, log captures, malware samples)

**[LIVE DATA ANALYSIS]**

Were all devices and data collected by trained personnel, following chain-of-custody procedures? (Evidence handling protocols)

**[LIVE DATA ANALYSIS]**

What is the timeline of the intrusion and incident events? (Dates/times of initial compromise, discovery, and response)

**[LIVE DATA ANALYSIS]**

What category of cybercrime is suspected (e.g. hacking, phishing, malware, ransomware, identity theft)?

**[LIVE DATA ANALYSIS]**

Which digital assets or user accounts were targeted or compromised? (Email accounts, cloud storage, network credentials)

**[LIVE DATA ANALYSIS]**

Do you want to add any additional details about the cyber crime?
